name: Boulton Center for the Performing Arts

evidence.note: Business listing describes a 261-seat stadium-style theater in the former Regent movie theater.
Reviews praise sloped seating where every seat sees the stage; none mention dancing.
Venue home page lists upcoming concerts and stresses that every seat is close to the stage.

dancing.notes: All seats are fixed theater seats on a sloped floor, and we found no dance area. Plan on a seated concert.

description: A 260-seat theater on Main Street in downtown Bay Shore, in a former movie house built in 1929. A nonprofit foundation runs it, and it hosts concerts, tribute bands and comedy shows most weekends.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). CHECK THE GIG: the Boulton Center's own site lists 'From Dublin to Duluth' on Oct 3, and Leonid & Friends' tour page puts them in Skokie, IL that night. Ira's Leonid & Friends listing here looks wrong. Facebook URL comes from a venue directory, not the venue's site.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Description updated: the current text says it is run with the YMCA, which is out of date - the YMCA era ended in 2020; since reopening in Nov 2023 it is run by The Great South Bay Arts and Entertainment Foundation (Boulton family). Facebook changed: the site links a newer page (profile.php?id=61551692775450); the current https://www.facebook.com/BoultonCenter/ came from a directory and is probably the old YMCA-era page. The TikTok handle really is @the.boulton.cente (no final 'r'; the account exists). A second public email, GM@boultoncenter.org (general manager), is on the contact page. Hours recorded are box-office hours; shows run on their own schedule. It is a seated theater with no dance floor. Photos: the site's stage photos carry a 'Photo by Steven Sandick' watermark, and two theater-interior images are AI-generated (file names 'ChatGPT Image'), so no photos were recorded; the owner could ask the theater for unwatermarked photos. The Oct 3 'Leonid & Friends' listing flagged earlier is not on the venue's calendar (its upcoming shows start Oct 10).
hours: Box office: Wed-Sat 9 AM-5 PM; closed Sun-Tue (shows as scheduled)

Our Story page: 260-seat theater in the former Regent movie theater (1929); YMCA ran it 2003-2020; the Boulton family bought it back in 2023 and a nonprofit foundation now runs it.
Home page lists October-November 2026 shows (tribute bands, rock, comedy) and links Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
